translations.whatsNew.title: What's new
translations.whatsNew.heading: What's new: each release note, checked
translations.whatsNew.intro: Each case takes one line of an ng-native release note, runs it live, and says what was seen on a simulator and an emulator.
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.title: Dialogs.choose() on Cancel
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.note: On iOS, picking Cancel or dismissing the sheet resolves null, as on Android.
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.title: Deep link pushed over the screen
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.note: A link that arrives while the app runs is pushed over the screen showing, and Back returns to it.
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.title: ng-deep after a selector
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.note: A rule written as host, then ng-deep, then .inner styles .inner in the components the host holds; with nothing before ng-deep it is still dropped.
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.title: dark class on the root view
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.note: dark: applies to the view that has the dark class itself, not only to what is inside it.
translations.whatsNew.a10_5.title: Border with no color
translations.whatsNew.a10_5.note: A border with a width and no color is drawn in the text color, not black.
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.title: One long word
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.note: A single word is one line cut at the box edge, not wrapped between letters; several words still wrap.
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.title: z-index across plain views
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.note: A box with a z-index is drawn over what follows the plain views it sits in.
translations.whatsNew.unknown: No cases for this version yet.
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.box: The box itself has the class
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.on: dark class: on (the background should be near black)
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.off: dark class: off (the background should be white)
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.how: With this screen showing, send the app a link from a terminal, then press Back in the header.
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.expected: Expected: the Device demo opens over this screen, and Back returns here, not to an earlier screen.
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.hint: Pick Save or Discard to see an index. Pick Cancel to see null; on iOS, tapping outside the sheet does too.
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.with: Something before ng-deep: should be crimson
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.bare: Nothing before ng-deep: should stay gray
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.hint: Expected: the word on one line, cut at the edge of its box; the three words on three lines.
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.hint: Expected, from the top: 3, then 2, then 1, whatever the order in the tree.
